subtopic_title: Identification and properties of: vertically opposite, adjacent, alternate, and corresponding angles.
curriculum_objective_text: Identify vertically opposite, adjacent, alternate and corresponding angles

record_links.rationale: This worked example identifies a corresponding angle pair between parallel lines.

heading_path.h3: Worked example 15.11: Recognising pairs of angles between parallel lines

record.evidence_quote: In the diagram below, $AB \parallel CD$ and $EF$ is a transversal. Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_005.png What type of angle pair is shown by the shaded angles? What is the relationship between the two angles?
record.prompt_text:
In the diagram below, $AB \parallel CD$ and $EF$ is a transversal.

Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_005.png

What type of angle pair is shown by the shaded angles? What is the relationship between the two angles?
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Consider the diagram and remember the three types of angles formed by two parallel lines and a transversal.

F: corresponding angles are equal

U: co-interior angles are supplementary

N: alternate angles are equal

Step 2: Identify the type of angle pair.

If we draw a shape around the angles, we will see an "F" shape. This helps us to identify corresponding angles.

Highlighted image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-1.png

Step 3: Give the correct answers.

The shaded angles are corresponding angles.

The corresponding angles are equal because $AB \parallel CD$.

record_links.rationale: This item asks learners to recognise a corresponding angle pair and state its relationship.

closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The textbook explicitly teaches co-interior angles alongside corresponding and alternate angles, and includes an exercise item for recognising them. The canonical curriculum list names alternate and corresponding angles but omits co-interior angles.

closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Apply angle relationships in real-world contexts.
closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: we can apply our knowledge in real life.
closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The practical-application records ask learners to use angle relationships in map, painting, and contextual diagrams. They depend on the existing angle relationships but express a distinct application objective.
